The absolute-trend gate is the sole validated risk-control edge, while cross-sectional rank has no predictive power. Macro headlines are dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: As the highest-ranked theme with trend eligibility (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.61) and not crowded, the detector suggests staying with the ongoing trend for risk-controlled exposure. The lack of extreme crowding or one-narrative dominance allows trend-following exposure, consistent with the gate's drawdown-reduction history.
theses.dissent: The relative momentum rank has no predictive edge; the theme may simply have already run its course, and the small durability_bar (0.61) suggests only moderate trend strength. A macro shift or rotation could quickly reverse leadership without warning.

falsifier.text: The theme loses eligibility (trend gate breaks) OR durability_bar drops below 0.55 on the next read.

evidence: durability_bar 0.45, hurst_tag=trend but not eligible (trend gate not met)
